source_evidence: The direction-return contract is expressed in the implementation of entity-ad68dc9f4e23e9f904637b5702611a67df91dc516703f8e6ea05dbc03f33ad6c (?find@Path@@QAEHHHHHHHHH@Z, src/path.cpp line 197, working-tree file sha256 bc3b02f54c97544a4ff9efd210df7da14d477fa0838cec7f70b0474b1f1cffab matching the request's restoration source_evidence): src/path.cpp:727-731 initializes best_dir = -1 / best_score = 2000000000 (the image's 0x77359400 at 0x0059B407/0x0059B411) and scans i in [0,8) over RadiusBaseX/RadiusBaseY; src/path.cpp:704-705 returns -1 when the search never reached the source and src/path.cpp:893 returns best_dir.

The adjacent-destination early return is live code, not a marker note: src/path.cpp:735-737 `if (x_next == x_dst && y_next == y_dst) return i;` reproduces the 0x0059BBF9 return of the direction counter [ebp-0x1c] itself.

The scoring and backtrack penalty are the reconstruction's final block: src/path.cpp:883-885 `if (unk2 >= 0 && unk2 < 8 && (i ^ 4) == unk2) cost += 20 * (int)Rules.move_rate_roads;` matches 0x0059BB95-0x0059BBB9 (signed [0,8) test, xor 4, lea ecx,[eax+edx*4] on move_rate_roads*5), and src/path.cpp:886-890 `int score = cost * 2 + (i & 1); if (score <= best_score)` matches 0x0059BBC5-0x0059BBD5, preferring cardinal directions on ties.

The sea-standoff counter store is expressed at src/path.cpp:877-878: inside the open-water artillery scan (:856-876, can_arty/vendetta test over RadiusOffset 1..24) the body executes `i = 25;` with the comment naming the image's store (0x0059B25C/0x0059BAD7) - 25+1 fails the <8 loop exit at the bottom and neither (i ^ 4) nor (i & 1) can match 25, exactly the hypothesis's loop-termination effect. Path::move (entity-f0f3708a5bdc58c456cfdb7f94a520fa330aa4ccfc7a4a39e18026b4f8f8da1a) records the consumer side at src/path.cpp:959-994: its WIP tail note traces the call into Path::find at 0x0059BE66 passing the previous direction and consuming the returned index, and the transcribed marker at src/path.cpp:307-337 documents the same contract.
